words.example: File the incident report before you go off shift, while you remember.
words.exampleZh: 下班前趁还记得，把不良事件报告写好。

words.example: That near miss happened because two labels looked almost the same.
words.exampleZh: 那起未遂事件是因为两张标签看起来几乎一样。

words.example: The root cause was a roster change that nobody passed on.
words.exampleZh: 根本原因是排班改了，却没有人传达下去。

words.example: The corrective action is a read-back of the patient name at handover.
words.exampleZh: 纠正措施是交接时把患者姓名复述一遍。

words.example: The preventive action is to separate look-alike drugs on the shelf.
words.exampleZh: 预防措施是把看起来相似的药品在架子上分开。

words.example: Local admin on this kiosk was used to install a chat program.
words.exampleZh: 有人用这台自助终端的本地管理员装了一个聊天程序。

words.example: Domain admin membership for the vendor account should end today.
words.exampleZh: 厂商账号的域管理员身份今天应该收回。

words.example: The service desk already has twelve calls about the slow order screen.
words.exampleZh: 服务台已经接到十二通关于医嘱界面变慢的电话。

words.example: The helpdesk closed the printer call before the ward said printing worked.
words.exampleZh: 病区还没说打印恢复，技术支持台就把这张单关了。

words.example: L1 support reset the password and passed the rest to the application team.
words.exampleZh: 一线支持重置了密码，其余问题转给了应用组。
